verdict.rationale: MX's own Connect Widget docs show bank-hosted OAuth flows: the financial institution's OAuth window must be loaded in the device's native browser when the widget is embedded in a WebView (mx-docs-23, mx-docs-42). However, its aggregation widget is also described as prompting users to connect with their credentials (mx-docs-9), so credential-based linking remains a documented path. Missing for 10: documentation of which major institutions use OAuth (coverage list), any plan or timeline for retiring legacy credential/screen-scraping flows, and independent corroboration of OAuth-first connectivity.
